contributions.detail: Page 2 (Form A) is entirely blank at 200 dpi -- not one inked line in the 40-line grid. Cover line 1 reads LAST 1521. / THIS a bare dash / CUMULATIVE 1521., i.e. the filer received nothing over $50 in THIS period and the 1521. cycle-to-date figure was itemized on an earlier report that is not part of this document. Zero rows therefore equals the THIS-REPORT cell (scope=period). The Carr form prints NO schedule total on Form A, so the cover line is the only anchor. Note the published filing_totals stated_total_contributions for this filing is line1+line2; line 2 is a bare dash on all three columns.

expenditures.detail: 20 itemized expenditures dated 2009-03-15 through 2012-09-07 sum to EXACTLY 1267.00, which equals cover line 3 CUMULATIVE REPORT '1267.'. The LAST and THIS cells of line 3 are both left empty by the filer (no dash, no figure), so the cumulative cell is the only printed expenditure anchor and the rows are unambiguously on the cumulative (whole-cycle) scope -- they span four calendar years on a single sheet. The Carr form prints no schedule total on Form B.

gates.page_subtotal: Form B (p3) has NO printed schedule total or page subtotal -- the Carr 5-5-PG sheet ends with '(If additional space is needed, use blank paper ...)'. No donor addresses were exposed (Form A blank); the candidate's own street address, ZIP and cell number on the cover were discarded at read time.
